theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_glc_good_radius
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (ρ ρ' : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (I : ℝ≥0∞) (p : ℝ → Prop), ρ < ρ' → μ (closedBall y ρ') ≠ ∞ → AEMeasurable g → ∫⁻ t, g t ≤ I → (∀ᵐ t, p t) → ∃ t : ℝ, ρ < t ∧ t < ρ' ∧ p t ∧ μ (sphere y t) = 0 ∧ g t ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (ρ' - ρ)) * I
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
